## Description
 &#10;&#9;&#9;Method 1: Compression Molding (primary method for large flat sheets)&#10;&#9;&#9;Method 2: Ram Extrusion (semi-continuous, for thinner sheets)&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;UHMW-PE is roughly 1/8 the weight of steel at the same thickness — that&#39;s why it&#39;s popular for &#10;&#9;&#9;wear plates, liners, and impact shields where you need toughness without the mass.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;Each UHMW-PE Board weights 23.3 kg&#10;&#9;&#9;
